newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece drains 250 bln drachs at 11.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece drains 250 bln drachs at 11.90 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Greece drained 250 billion drachmas of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent in today's fixed interest rate tender, it said.
"Individual bids were satisfied pro rata on the basis of the ensuing allotment ratio of 45.12 percent," it said.
A pact of 200 billion drachmas of 14-day funds was expiring today so that a net amount of about 50 billion drachmas is leaving the market.

"It is an unpleasant surprise that will push short-term rates higher," said a money market trader. "The market was expecting the central bank to drain an amount smaller than 200 billion drachmas." --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
